title: Isaac Sends Jacob to Paddan-Aram
description: Isaac called Jacob to him, blessed him, and commanded him not to take a wife from the daughters of Canaan, but to go to Paddan-Aram to find a wife among the daughters of Laban, his mother's brother. He asked El Shaddai to bless Jacob with Abraham's blessing. Jacob obeyed and set out. When Esau saw that his father had sent Jacob away and that the daughters of Canaan displeased Isaac, he went to Ishmael and took Mahalat, the daughter of Ishmael, as a wife in addition to his other wives.
